YOUR FIRST CONVERSATION

Start with a question.
Leave with a direction.

A focused introductory conversation about your email, bookings and account protection, not a request for confidential client information.

What we will discuss

  1. Your practice size and the tools you rely on.
  2. How accounts are protected and recovered.
  3. Your main concerns and existing IT support.
  4. Whether a scoped review would be useful.

This is a discovery conversation, not a penetration test, incident-response service or compliance certificate.

BOOKING

Your practice. Your questions.

Plan your consultation ↗

The booking calendar is being connected. No appointment can be submitted from this page yet.

When available, the booking link will open Calendly directly. Please do not put passwords, client names, clinical notes or other sensitive information in booking fields.

Explore the proposed review scopes ↗

Before the conversation

Bring a list of the email, booking and document services you use, plus any questions you want to resolve. You do not need to export data or send screenshots containing client information.

If your practice already has IT support, note what they manage so any proposed work complements it.

Experiencing an incident now?

Contact your existing IT provider and, if you have one, your cyber insurer’s incident-response contact. This website is not monitored as an emergency response channel.
